# Category Module API Documentation

**Base URL:** `https://server.sohojogi.com.bd/api/v1`

---

## 1. List Categories
Retrieve a paginated list of all active service categories.

- **URL:** `/categories`
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Auth Required:** No (Public)
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `search` (string, optional) - Search term for category name/description.
  - `page` (number, optional) - Page number for pagination.
  - `limit` (number, optional) - Number of items per page.
  - `sortBy` (string, optional) - Field to sort by (e.g., `sortOrder`).
  - `sortOrder` (string, optional) - `asc` or `desc`.

## 2. Get Single Category
Retrieve details of a specific category by its ID.

- **URL:** `/categories/:categoryId`
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Auth Required:** No (Public)
- **URL Parameters:**
  - `categoryId` (ObjectId) - The ID of the category.

## 3. Create Category
Create a new service category.

- **URL:** `/categories`
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Admin, Super-Admin)
- **Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`
- **Body:**
  - `name` (string, required) - Name of the category.
  - `description` (string, optional) - Brief description.
  - `sortOrder` (number, optional) - Display order ranking (default: 0).
  - `icon` (file, required) - Image file for the category icon (will be optimized to 200x200 WebP and uploaded to Cloudinary).

## 4. Update Category
Update an existing service category.

- **URL:** `/categories/:categoryId`
- **Method:** `PATCH`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Admin, Super-Admin)
- **Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`
- **URL Parameters:**
  - `categoryId` (ObjectId) - The ID of the category.
- **Body:** 
  - `name` (string, optional)
  - `description` (string, optional)
  - `sortOrder` (number, optional)
  - `icon` (file, optional) - New image file to replace the existing icon.

## 5. Delete Category
Soft delete a category (sets `isActive: false`).

- **URL:** `/categories/:categoryId`
- **Method:** `DELETE`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Admin, Super-Admin)
- **URL Parameters:**
  - `categoryId` (ObjectId) - The ID of the category to delete.

---

## 6. List Category Requests
Retrieve a paginated list of category requests submitted by users.

- **URL:** `/categories/requests`
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Admin, Super-Admin)
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `status` (string, optional) - Filter by status (`PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`).
  - `page` (number, optional)
  - `limit` (number, optional)

## 7. Submit Category Request
Submit a request to add a new service category to the platform.

- **URL:** `/categories/requests`
- **Method:** `POST`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Customer, Provider)
- **Content-Type:** `application/json`
- **Body Example:**
```json
{
  "name": "Plumbing",
  "description": "Pipe fixing, installation, and general plumbing services."
}
```

## 8. Review Category Request
Approve or reject a submitted category request.

- **URL:** `/categories/requests/:requestId/review`
- **Method:** `PATCH`
- **Auth Required:** Yes (Admin, Super-Admin)
- **Content-Type:** `application/json`
- **URL Parameters:**
  - `requestId` (ObjectId) - The ID of the category request.
- **Body Example:**
```json
{
  "status": "APPROVED",
  "adminNotes": "Approved and added to the plumbing tools category stack."
}
```
*(Note: Valid status values are `APPROVED` or `REJECTED`)*
